messages.content: "Can you help me with the following tasks? First, I want to find the closest high-rated grocery stores from my location at '123 Main Street, New York' that have 'milk', 'bread', and 'eggs' in stock. The store should have a minimum rating of 4.5. Second, I am interested in knowing more about the sculpture titled 'The Thinker' made by the artist 'Auguste Rodin'. I specifically want to know about its 'material'. Lastly, I drove my car, which uses 'diesel' as fuel and has a fuel efficiency of 25 miles per gallon, for a total distance of 12000 miles last year. Can you calculate the annual carbon dioxide emissions produced by my vehicle? Also, consider a 2% decrease in fuel efficiency per year."

function.name: grocery_store_find_best
function.description: Find the closest high-rated grocery stores based on certain product availability. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

my_location.description: The current location of the user.

rating.description: The minimum required store rating. Default is 5.0. This is a float type value.

function.name: calculate_emissions
function.description: Calculates the annual carbon dioxide emissions produced by a vehicle based on the distance traveled, the fuel type and the fuel efficiency of the vehicle. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

fuel_type.description: Type of fuel used by the vehicle.

fuel_efficiency.description: The vehicle's fuel efficiency in miles per gallon.

efficiency_reduction.description: The percentage decrease in fuel efficiency per year (optional). Default is 0

function.name: sculpture_get_details
function.description: Retrieve details of a sculpture based on the artist and the title of the sculpture. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

artist.description: The artist who made the sculpture.

detail.description: The specific detail wanted about the sculpture. Default is 'general information'.
